MORE:
This is to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held today i.e. on Thursday, 13th November, 2026 has considered and approved the Un-audited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026, as reviewed and recommended by the Audit Committee.

Pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 and 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we enclose herewith the following documents:

1. Un-audited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026.
2. Statement of Assets and Liabilities for the Half Year ended on 30th September, 2026.
3. Statement of Cash Flows for the Half Year ended on 30th September, 2026.
4. Limited Review Report issued by the Statutory Auditors of the Company.
